requirements: R1: The backend container must start without port allocation conflicts for port 18080.

slices.title: Resolve backend container port conflict
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to reconfigure or remove the conflicting port binding, so that the backend container starts successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker-compose setup,
When the environment is launched with `docker compose up`,
Then the backend container starts without a port allocation error on 0.0.0.0:18080.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero port conflict errors on startup
